help.install.android: Android (Chrome): menu ⋮ → “Install app” or “Add to home screen”.

help.install.offline: After installation the app also works offline. Changes are transferred as soon as you are back online.

help.keyboardText: Tab and Shift+Tab move between elements, Enter or Space activates, Esc closes dialogs and info popups. In charts the arrow keys move between values.
help.apiText: All features are available through a documented REST API. Create an access token in your profile.

legal.imprint.title: Imprint
legal.imprint.note: Note for operators: replace the placeholders in square brackets with the real details before going live.
legal.imprint.provider: Information according to § 5 German Digital Services Act (DDG)
legal.imprint.disputeText: We are neither willing nor obliged to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.lead: In short: we only store what BudgetPlaner needs to work – encrypted, without ads, without tracking and without bank connection.
legal.privacy.dataText: Account: email address, name, language, time zone. Financial data you enter yourself: budget items, debts, buffers, balances, notes. Technical: signed-in devices (device name, timestamps), push subscriptions, change history. Amounts, names and notes are stored encrypted.
legal.privacy.purposeText: Processing serves solely to provide BudgetPlaner (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). You only receive emails and push notifications for sign-in, invitations and the notifications you enabled in your profile.
legal.privacy.storageText: For offline mode the app also stores your household data locally in the browser (IndexedDB) as well as sign-in data and settings in local storage. There are no advertising or analytics cookies. Signing out deletes the local data.
legal.privacy.sharingText: Members of your household see the shared data. We do not share data with third parties – except technical service providers for hosting, email delivery and push delivery acting only on our behalf.
legal.privacy.retentionText: Data is stored as long as your account exists. After deleting the account, personal data is removed immediately; backups are overwritten after 14 days at the latest.
legal.privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection. You can trigger access (data export) and deletion yourself at any time in your profile. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.
legal.privacy.securityText: Transmission is always encrypted (TLS), sign-in without password via email code or passkey, encrypted storage of financial data, daily backups.
onboarding.title: Welcome to BudgetPlaner!
onboarding.intro: Your first budget is ready in three short steps – it takes less than five minutes. You can skip at any time and continue later.
onboarding.monthStart: When does your budget month start?
onboarding.monthStartHint: Ideally on the day your salary arrives.
onboarding.income.title: What comes in each month?
onboarding.income.text: Net salaries, child benefit, side jobs – everything that regularly lands in your account.
onboarding.fixed.title: What fixed costs do you have?
onboarding.fixed.text: Only fill in what applies to you – empty fields are ignored.
onboarding.goal.title: Your first savings goal
onboarding.goal.text: An emergency fund absorbs unexpected expenses. Recommendation: three months of income.
onboarding.summary.title: This is your month
onboarding.summary.leftText: In the budget you give this remainder a job – e.g. leisure, clothing or more reserves.
onboarding.summary.over: You planned more than comes in. Check the amounts in the budget.
onboarding.done: Your budget is set up – now give every euro a job!
